column1: # The contracted flight chain, stepped 180 times at 1/60 s.
# The stick: one second of pitch, one of roll, one centred. Nothing here
# is retail data -- the aircraft numbers are the base constructor's
# defaults and the gains are chosen. What IS retail is every rule the
# chain applies to them, each with its own micro-execution differential.
# POSITION IS ABSENT, and not by omission: the live model's position step
# is 0x823042D0, which cycle 1383 showed depends on vrefp and vrsqrtefp,
# estimate instructions whose exact bits belong to the console. The
# aeroplane changes attitude here; it does not move.
